en: A black‑and‑white photograph taken from inside a car looking out through the windshield onto a narrow rural road. Cows are standing on the road, partly blocking the car. A man in work clothes and cap stands among the cows, and a woman in a dress and apron walks away on the right side of the frame. The road is flanked by trees and vegetation, giving a forested countryside feel. No visible printed text appears on the image.
